result.summary: The restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel have inconsistent delivery-time badge placement and overflow, making the row look visually broken.

issues.description: The delivery-time badges on the three 'Fastest near you' cards are not aligned consistently: the first sits inside the image, the middle badge overflows the image onto the title area, and the third is clipped at the card edge. This makes the carousel look messy and hard to scan.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent badge position (e.g. always bottom-left inside the image with enough padding and overflow:hidden on the image container) so badges stay aligned and fully visible on every card.
